card.name: Linking words before patient populations
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, to, especially, and the word patients, placed just before a group of people in warning or adverse-event text. Often follows 'seen in', 'reported in', or 'compared'.

modes.label: Words before a population
modes.description: 'of', 'especially' or 'to' sit right before a described population or comparison group.

modes.description: The word patients follows 'in' when a finding is described as seen or reported in a subgroup.
